builds.name: Reference: Ranked top core
builds.goal: Reference for Fiora: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ top players use most (9,106 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 59.4% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A directional duelist who moves around exposed Vitals and saves Riposte for key retaliation, favoring isolated fights. The current top provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Ravenous Hydra → Trinity Force → Death's Dance. Press the Attack keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Plated Steelcaps, Guardian Angel, Sterak's Gage.
builds.summary: The proven top baseline: Ravenous Hydra → Trinity Force → Death's Dance, with Press the Attack.
testPlan: Play it in top as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Ravenous Hydra → Trinity Force → Death's Dance) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 59.4% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Ravenous Hydra → Trinity Force → Death's Dance.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Fiora identifies Vitals on enemy champions. Hitting this Vital with an Attack or Ability deals an additional [0.03 + (0.0004) × AD[statFormula=2]] max Health true damage, grants Fiora @spell.FioraR:PercentMS*100@% Move Speed decaying over [2] seconds, and restores [characterLevelInterpolation(35 → 100; raw flags preserved)] Health.

Fiora reveals a new Vital after 15 seconds or after striking one.

Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs the closest enemy, ward, or structure, dealing [70 / 80 / 90 / 100 / 110 + (0.9 / 0.95 / 1 / 1.05 / 1.1) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage. The strike will prioritize Vitals and enemies it will kill.

If Fiora strikes an enemy, this Ability's Cooldown is reduced by [50]%.

Passive: {{Spell_FioraPassive_Name}} Move Speed bonus is increased to [(0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5) × 100]%.

Active: Fiora reveals all four Vitals on a champion for a max of @spell.FioraPassive:RDamageTotal@ max Health true damage and gains {{Spell_FioraPassive_Name}}'s Move Speed bonus while near the target.

If Fiora strikes all four Vitals within [8] seconds or if the target dies after she has hit at least one, Fiora restores [80 / 105 / 130 + (0.7) × AD[statFormula=2]] Health per second to surrounding allied champions for [5] seconds.

Fiora parries all incoming damage, disables, and negative effects for [0.75] seconds, then stabs. The stab deals [110 / 150 / 190 / 230 / 270 + (1) × AP] magic damage to the first champion hit and Slows Move Speed by [50]% and Attack Speed by [25]%  for [2] seconds. If Fiora parries an Immobilizing effect, the stabbed enemy is Stunned rather than Slowed.

Fiora gains [(0.5 / 0.6 / 0.7 / 0.8 / 0.9) × 100]% Attack Speed for her next two Attacks. The first Attack Slows by [30]% for [1] second. The second Attack always critically strikes for [(1.6 / 1.7 / 1.8 / 1.9 / 2) × 100]% damage.

builds.name: Vital orbit attack engine
builds.summary: Use attack windows to reach all four real Vitals.
builds.goal: Use attack windows to reach all four real Vitals.
builds.hypothesis: Duelist's Dance deals percent-max-health true damage with an AD statFormula expression and rewards directional hits. Lunge's hit halves its cooldown; Trinity and Blade reward attack weaving, while Ravenous sustain helps tolerate orbiting. Hullbreaker's fifth attack adds separate physical pressure, and E's two fast attacks create brief movement-safe damage windows.
testPlan: Required state: Need open space around the target, Q hits and all four sides accessible before eight seconds.
Record Vital completions and ordinary attack damage separately in a wall-side versus open duel.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Walls can block Vitals; attack items encourage standing still instead of completing R.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Item proc damage is not automatically percent-health true damage or a new independent Vital hit.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Trinity Force, Blade of The Ruined King, Hullbreaker, Ravenous Hydra, Death's Dance, Boots of Swiftness. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Physical matchup
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Fiora: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A directional duelist who moves around exposed Vitals and saves Riposte for key retaliation, favoring isolated fights. Fix vital access and target max HP; record Riposte timing. Crit/penetration do not automatically multiply vital true damage, and attack speed is wasted without directional access. Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
builds.summary: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Fiora: Fix vital access and target max HP; record Riposte timing. Crit/penetration do not automatically multiply vital true damage, and attack speed is wasted without directional access.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then matchup armor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Armor and access may turn survival into additional attack/spell windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy, dealing physical damage and applying on-hit effects. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.

The route fails Fiora's stated kit question: Fix vital access and target max HP; record Riposte timing. Crit/penetration do not automatically multiply vital true damage, and attack speed is wasted without directional access.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Randuin is conditional on the enemy attack/crit profile; it costs an offensive slot.
Full cost 16,100 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then matchup armor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Randuin's Omen, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Grand Challenge team-heal bruiser
builds.summary: Keep enough health and AD to complete a healing field under pressure.
builds.goal: Keep enough health and AD to complete a healing field under pressure.
builds.hypothesis: Grand Challenge's completed field heals nearby allies for 80-130 plus 0.7 AD statFormula=2 per second over five seconds. Bloodmail converts bonus health into AD supporting Vitals and that field; Sundered Sky and Visage stabilize Fiora during setup. Riposte's 0.75-second parry offers a specific survival window before the first Vital.
testPlan: Required state: Need at least one Vital then a kill, or all four within R's eight seconds.
Compare field healing and completion rate versus a higher-damage build while surrounded by two opponents.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Anti-heal and blocked access undermine both self sustain and team payoff.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Visage improves heals received by Fiora, not the full allied healing field for everyone.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Sundered Sky, Spirit Visage, Black Cleaver, Sterak's Gage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
